title: Atomic Actual-WOFOST Crop-Owner State and Read-Only View Composition
purpose: Create the smallest route-specific transaction state that atomically owns current WOFOST crop lifecycle identity and primary actual biomass, without duplicating LAI or introducing WOFOST evolution. Expose read-only current-state views for downstream root/canopy composition.

atomic_owner_state.biomass_presence_rule: allocated exactly when the WOFOST crop is emerged in this admitted state shape

LAI_reconciliation.F_WOF20_common_carrier: stores leaf_area_index for the previously admitted common route
LAI_reconciliation.WOFOST_source_semantics: actual WOFOST LAI is recalculated from LASUM + SSA*WST + SPA*WSO
LAI_reconciliation.WOFOST_composite_decision: do not embed crop_lifecycle_state_t because that would create a second independent LAI value beside the authoritative biomass-derived WOFOST LAI
LAI_reconciliation.leaf_area_index: read-only derived view from primary biomass plus immutable SSA/SPA parameters

optional_state_scaling.emerged_WOFOST_column: allocate only the compact F-WOF23 primary biomass carrier

read_only_views.actual_root_biomass: returns authoritative F-WOF23 root_biomass when emerged; unavailable otherwise
read_only_views.actual_leaf_area_index: LASUM + SSA*WST + SPA*WSO, with SSA and SPA supplied as immutable parameters

transaction_semantics: deep clone must isolate allocatable biomass/cohort history
F-KT checkpoint must capture lifecycle and biomass atomically
discarded trial must not mutate either lifecycle or biomass
same-checkpoint replay must be bitwise deterministic
biomass allocation/deallocation is part of candidate physical state and only becomes committed through F-KT

downstream_composition.F_WOF17_SWRD3: feed actual_root_biomass into existing build_swrd3_root_geometry_snapshot without changing geometry physics
downstream_composition.canopy_ET: future canopy producer may consume derived actual_leaf_area_index; F-WOF24 does not implement CF, vcover or ET physics

forbidden: nested F-WOF20 leaf_area_index as a second WOFOST LAI authority
WRTPOT or potential biomass in the primary owner
